destination.title: Six-dimensional theories: geometry, anomalies, symmetries and limits
destination.question: How do geometry, anomalies, symmetry structures and limiting or compactification regimes organize six-dimensional field theories and string vacua?
destination.summary: A useful broad family spans gravity-coupled theories, decoupled SCFTs, string vacua and their lower-dimensional descriptions. No original scientific region statement was supplied, so the critique concerns numerical membership rather than an attributed universal claim. The proposed scope separates physical targets and retains adjacent applications.

systems: Six-dimensional SCFTs and proposed critical theories
Six-dimensional string vacua with differing supersymmetry
Associated branes, strings and chiral form fields
targets: Anomaly cancellation and further consistency conditions
regimes: Dynamical gravity and gravity decoupling are separate regimes
Tensor, Higgs and mixed branches where specified
Circle and torus reductions and lower-dimensional applications
Frozen and unfrozen constructions where specified
assumptions: Numerical selection roles do not establish scientific membership
Anomaly cancellation alone is not treated as sufficient for ultraviolet consistency
A missing construction does not by itself establish inconsistency
conventions: Preserve source supersymmetry labels and form degrees
Distinguish operator mass dimension from spacetime dimension
Preserve source dates and conjectural versus demonstrated status
includes: Relevant outside probes of six-dimensional consistency
Explicitly labeled method and application overlaps
excludes: Standard Model operator classification as a six-dimensional member solely because it concerns dimension-six operators
Claims of universal classification or fine-question equivalence unsupported by the supplied material

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: How can a six-dimensional theory with gravity decoupled be encoded geometrically? Noncompact F-theory bases contain compact curves controlling tensor-branch strings, while singular elliptic fibers encode gauge algebras and charged matter.

sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: How do chiral anomalies obstruct circle lifts of odd-dimensional theories, and can five-dimensional BPS-string unitarity constrain six-dimensional supergravity and elliptic Calabi–Yau geometry?

sources.title: 6D SCFTs, center-flavor symmetries, and Stiefel-Whitney compactifications

evidence.text: How can tensor-branch data determine the continuous zero-form symmetry group of a 6d SCFT, including Abelian and R-symmetry mixing, and enable Stiefel–Whitney twisted torus compactifications to 4d N=2 SCFTs?

sources.title: On the 6d origin of non-invertible symmetries in 4d

evidence.text: How can six-dimensional (2,0) theories geometrically diagnose mixed zero-form/one-form anomalies and construct four-dimensional class S theories with non-invertible M-ality defects?

sources.title: The Branes Behind Generalized Symmetry Operators

evidence.text: How can wrapped branes explicitly realize generalized symmetry operators in geometrically engineered QFTs, and determine their worldvolume TFTs and fusion rules, particularly for 6D SCFTs?

sources.title: Geometric bounds on the 1-form gauge sector

evidence.text: Which discrete center 1-form gauge groups can occur in six-dimensional minimally supersymmetric F-theory vacua, and can their geometric bounds acquire a heterotic interpretation or extend to general quantum gravity and four dimensions?

sources.title: On the frozen F-theory landscape

evidence.text: Can frozen and unfrozen 6d N=(1,0) F-theory supergravities be distinguished using non-Abelian gauge algebras, massless matter, or accessible gauge enhancements? Which local frozen SCFT/LST constructions admit compact embeddings?

sources.title: SymTFTs and non-invertible symmetries of 6d (2,0) SCFTs of type D from M-theory

evidence.text: How does M-theory determine the discrete SymTFT, absolute global variants, and non-invertible symmetries of 6d (2,0) D_N SCFTs, and reproduce their gravitational/R-symmetry anomaly polynomial?

sources.title: Generalized Green-Schwarz mechanism in F theory

evidence.text: Which restrictions on six-dimensional 7-brane matter follow from generalized Green–Schwarz anomaly cancellation and intersection theory, and how can smooth versus singular worldvolumes realize different spectra with the same homological data?

sources.title: Global anomalies and geometric engineering of critical theories in six-dimensions

evidence.text: Which six-dimensional chiral gauge theories survive global gauge anomalies, and how does F-theory encode these restrictions and realize candidate N=1 critical theories?

sources.title: D = 6, N=1 string vacua and duality

evidence.text: How do anomaly cancellation, compactification geometry, T-duality and conjectured strong/weak dualities organize six-dimensional N=1 string vacua and their nonperturbative transitions? The lectures also examine the resulting four-dimensional N=2 theories.

sources.title: Notes on sphere-based universal extra dimensions

evidence.text: How are fields and interactions KK-expanded in sphere-based six-dimensional UED models, which constructions consistently remove the extra U(1)X gauge zero mode, and why can Higgs vacuum stability bound the effective theory's ultraviolet cutoff?

sources.title: Notes on sphere-based universal extra dimensions

evidence.text: Apply background-field splitting, a background-covariant gauge fixing and ghost expansion. Decompose tangent-space gauge components into physical and Nambu–Goldstone scalar modes, and use harmonic orthogonality to show that the Abelian monopole's linear fluctuation term vanishes.

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Enumerate repeated marks summing to k, delete the selected nodes and read the commutant. Match SCFT boundary deformations within a fixed parent family, brane number and undeformed tail; otherwise the labels describe families.

sources.title: Anomalies as obstructions: from dimensional lifts to swampland

evidence.text: Match a fixed physical smearing scale to the proper distance in the Taub-NUT metric, then demand that the source's coordinate support vanish. The resulting large integer-charge condition specifies the source's proposed regime of inflow control.

sources.title: 6D SCFTs, center-flavor symmetries, and Stiefel-Whitney compactifications

evidence.text: Extract 4d conformal and flavor central charges from 6d anomaly-polynomial coefficients, generic-Coulomb-branch multiplet counts, twist order, and flavor embedding indices. Compare proposed Coulomb spectra with 4(2a−c)=Σ_i(2Δ_i−1).

sources.title: On the 6d origin of non-invertible symmetries in 4d

evidence.text: Find mapping-class-group fixed surfaces, then invariant maximal isotropic lattices. Detect anomalies by transforming one-form backgrounds and extracting the Heisenberg normal-ordering phase. Higher-genus examples use polygon isometries and finite-field Jordan decomposition.

sources.title: The Branes Behind Generalized Symmetry Operators

evidence.text: M-/F-theory duality maps D3-branes on γ to M5-branes on the torus bundle T3 over γ. Mayer–Vietoris gives H1(T3)=Z⊕coker(ρ−1), providing ordinary torsion-linking data for the alternative reduction.

sources.title: Unifying the 6D $ \mathcal{N} $ = (1, 1) string landscape

evidence.text: What connected components and nonabelian gauge enhancements can occur in six-dimensional N=(1,1) string vacua, and can rank reduction organize all known components and predict additional ones?

sources.title: The discrete Green-Schwarz mechanism in 6D F-theory and elliptic genera of non-critical strings

evidence.text: How are global discrete gauge anomalies cancelled in six-dimensional F-theory supergravities, and how can their Green–Schwarz couplings be extracted from non-critical strings and compactification geometry?

sources.title: Exploring new constraints on Kähler moduli space of 6d $ \mathcal{N} $ = 1 supergravity

evidence.text: Can positivity and boundary consistency of five-dimensional Coulomb branches constrain anomaly-free six-dimensional supergravity beyond anomaly cancellation, particularly by fixing gauge-group global forms and required BPS-string excitations?

sources.title: Mapping 6D N = 1 supergravities to F-theory

evidence.text: How can anomaly-free chiral six-dimensional supergravity data be mapped systematically to F-theory geometry, and which failures of that map might reveal additional quantum consistency conditions or previously unknown string realizations?

sources.title: Five-brane effective action in $M$-theory.

evidence.text: How can one define the partition functions of the five-brane chiral two-form and the Type IIB chiral four-form, select the required extra geometric data, and establish five-brane perturbative anomaly cancellation?

sources.title: Distinguishing 6D (1, 0) SCFTs: An extension to the geometric construction

evidence.text: How can distinct 6d (1,0) SCFTs sharing apparent tensor-branch descriptions and conventional invariants be distinguished, and what additional geometric construction data captures their different Higgs branches?

sources.title: Emergent strings, duality and weak coupling limits for two-form fields

evidence.text: What replaces a gravitational effective description when a two-form gauge field becomes weakly coupled at infinite distance? The analyzed examples are six-dimensional F-theory and Type IIB compactifications with different supersymmetry.

sources.title: Notes on noncritical superstrings in various dimensions

evidence.text: How should the geometry, supersymmetry and global symmetries of noncritical superstrings be interpreted, and how does the six-dimensional theory encode its moduli and the simultaneous cigar and sine-Liouville interactions?

sources.title: A Modular invariant partition function for the five-brane

evidence.text: Can the free chiral two-form of the M5-brane admit an SL(6,Z)-invariant partition function on T^6, despite the difficulty of constructing a manifestly covariant six-dimensional Lagrangian?

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: What replaces a six-dimensional gauge theory as its gauge coupling vanishes at fixed gravitational strength? The paper studies wrapped D3-brane strings and their charged excitations along this Kähler-moduli limit.

sources.title: String Defects, Supersymmetry and the Swampland

evidence.text: Which string-defect consistency conditions constrain six-dimensional supergravity beyond anomaly cancellation, and how do explicit orientifolds delimit their applicability to BPS defects, stable non-BPS defects and localized supersymmetry breaking?

sources.title: Generic matter representations in 6D supergravity theories

evidence.text: Which matter representations occupy the largest-dimensional branches of six-dimensional supergravity for a specified gauge group?

sources.title: Anomaly-induced vanishing of brane partition functions

evidence.text: Can anomalies of brane worldvolume symmetries systematically explain vanishing partition functions and generalize Freed–Witten conditions to strong-coupling settings where the original worldsheet argument does not apply?

sources.title: The Swampland Distance Conjecture for Kähler moduli

evidence.text: Which restricted six-dimensional supergravity spectrum and tensor geometry form the starting point for comparing F-theory circle reduction with M-theory?

sources.title: Lectures on the Swampland Program in String Compactifications

evidence.text: How can the gauge coupling vanish without decompactifying the six-dimensional theory?

sources.title: Effective field theory of 6D SUSY RG Flows

evidence.text: How does the dilaton–axion effective action constrain six-dimensional RG flows when conformal and continuous global symmetries break together, particularly on tensor, Higgs and mixed branches of SCFTs?

sources.title: Gauged 2-form symmetries in 6D SCFTs coupled to gravity

evidence.text: Which discrete 2-form symmetries of 6D (2,0) and (1,0) SCFT sectors survive screening when coupled to gravity, and how does the embedding of string-charge lattices determine their gauging?

sources.title: 6d $ \mathcal{N} $ = (1, 0) anomalies on S$^{1}$ and F-theory implications

evidence.text: Where are six-dimensional abelian gauge anomalies encoded after circle compactification, how does Green-Schwarz cancellation descend to five dimensions, and what does this imply for F-theory models accessible through M/F duality?

sources.title: The fate of discrete 1-form symmetries in 6d

evidence.text: Which apparent center 1-form symmetries of weakly coupled 6d gauge theories survive coupling to dynamical tensors and BPS strings, and when can surviving subgroups be gauged?

sources.title: String islands, discrete theta angles and the 6D $ \mathcal{N} $ = (1) string landscape

evidence.text: Classify six-dimensional N=(1,1) asymmetric orbifolds with chiral gravitini, construct the missing type II string islands, and determine how discrete theta angles affect string and particle charges.

sources.title: Tensionless Strings and the Weak Gravity Conjecture

evidence.text: Can a six-dimensional brane gauge coupling vanish while the Planck mass remains finite? The investigation asks how compactification geometry and additional light degrees of freedom obstruct the apparent continuous global symmetry.

sources.title: On the Classification of 6D SCFTs and Generalized ADE Orbifolds

evidence.text: Which minimal six-dimensional SCFTs arise from F-theory, which quotient singularities can occur as their endpoint bases, and how can additional E-string sectors and gauge-algebra tunings generate non-minimal theories?

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: Does classifying geometric F-theory tensor branches exhaust six-dimensional SCFTs? Known string constructions and homomorphism matches support this possibility, while frozen phases and potential interacting tensorless theories leave gaps.

sources.title: 6d SCFTs and U(1) Flavour Symmetries

evidence.text: Can six-dimensional abelian gauge symmetries remain dynamical after gravity decouples, and how are the resulting abelian flavour symmetries characterized geometrically and on SCFT tensor branches?

sources.title: Top Down Approach to 6D SCFTs

evidence.text: How do string/M/F-theory constructions organize six-dimensional SCFTs, constrain their classification beyond anomaly cancellation, and permit calculations of anomalies, RG flows and protected state counts?

sources.title: End of the world boundaries for chiral quantum gravity theories

evidence.text: How can chiral but anomaly-free theories coupled to gravity admit end-of-the-world boundaries, and which strong-coupling mechanisms gap their chiral fields? The paper constructs examples in six and four dimensions.

sources.title: Geometric Symmetries and Topological Terms in F-theory and Field Theory

evidence.text: How do mass-independent Chern–Simons corrections constrain partial supersymmetry breaking and consistent truncations, and how do circle large gauge transformations connect anomaly cancellation to arithmetic structures in F-theory geometry?

sources.title: Gauge Fields, Fermions and Mass Gaps in 6D Brane Worlds

evidence.text: Can bulk gauge and charged fermion fields yield viable 4D degrees of freedom in warped 6D brane worlds? How do conical defects affect localization and permit a finite Kaluza–Klein mass gap at arbitrarily large internal volume?

sources.title: Branes and six-dimensional supersymmetric theories

evidence.text: How can brane configurations realize anomaly-free six-dimensional (0,1) theories, their proposed interacting strong-coupling fixed points, small-instanton transitions, and ultraviolet completions with gravity decoupled?

sources.title: Supergravity anomaly equations from modularity of Calabi--Yau threefolds

evidence.text: Can the local gravitational, gauge and mixed anomaly cancellation conditions of six-dimensional F-theory supergravity be understood geometrically through modular relations between classical intersections and fibral enumerative invariants?

destination.title: Moduli, inflation and cosmic evolution
destination.question: How do moduli stabilization and dynamics enable or constrain inflation, subsequent cosmic evolution and late-time scalar phenomena in string-motivated settings?
destination.summary: Inflation with stabilized moduli supplies the main connection. Reheating, relic dilution, thermal and nonlinear dynamics, scalar-force screening and dark energy remain distinguishable questions. Shared terminology or stabilization techniques do not make their mechanisms equivalent.

systems: Closed-string moduli, open-string and brane inflatons, and string-motivated scalar cosmologies
Visible and hidden sectors coupled to cosmologically active scalars
targets: Vacuum survival, fragmentation and relic dilution
Late scalar forces, dark energy and joint cosmological models
regimes: Inflationary, post-inflationary and late-time regimes kept separate
Cold, warm, particle-production-driven and secondary inflation
Four-dimensional effective descriptions and explicitly identified hotter bulk-radiation regimes
assumptions: Stabilization, hierarchy and matter-localization assumptions remain model-specific
Conjectural bounds are questions or conditional premises, not established universal constraints
conventions: Observational compatibility and forecasts retain their source dates

sources.title: Accidental Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Can a simple type IIB volume-modulus model realize accidental inflation, and can its fine-tuned saddle or inflection-point dynamics yield statistical predictions when embedded in a volume-weighted landscape scenario?

sources.title: String moduli inflation: An overview

evidence.text: How can closed string moduli drive controlled slow-roll inflation after moduli stabilization, which mechanisms address the η-problem, and what observable signatures distinguish the reviewed scenarios?

sources.title: Power Suppression at Large Scales in String Inflation

evidence.text: Could a transition in closed-string-modulus inflation generate the historically reported low-multipole CMB power suppression, and can Fibre Inflation connect the transition's timing and strength to string coupling and potential parameters?

sources.title: String cosmology — Large-field inflation in string theory

evidence.text: How can string theory provide symmetry protection, a trans-Planckian inflaton range and controlled moduli dynamics for large-field inflation, particularly axion monodromy, while connecting the construction to the scalar tilt n_s and tensor-to-scalar ratio r?

sources.title: Robust Inflation from Fibrous Strings

evidence.text: How robust are Fibre Inflation potentials and predictions under UV corrections, modulus stabilization and geometric generalization, and how large can their tensor signal become?

sources.title: Moduli Vacuum Misalignment and Precise Predictions in String Inflation

evidence.text: How does explicitly computed moduli vacuum misalignment change the post-inflationary history, preferred horizon-exit e-fold number Ne, and observable predictions of Kähler moduli inflation?

sources.title: Constraints on Kähler moduli inflation from reheating

evidence.text: How do reheating and a post-inflationary epoch dominated by cold volume-modulus particles change the inferred horizon-exit e-fold count and spectral tilt of Kähler moduli inflation, and its compatibility with the Planck datasets available to the authors?

sources.title: Oscillons from String Moduli

evidence.text: When can displaced string moduli fragment into oscillons during relaxation toward their post-inflationary minima, and what gravitational-wave signals or decompactification risks follow?

sources.title: Chiral Global Embedding of Fibre Inflation Models

evidence.text: Can fibre inflation admit a globally consistent embedding with chiral D7 matter and closed-string moduli stabilisation while satisfying Kähler-cone bounds, effective-field-theory hierarchies and primordial-perturbation requirements?

sources.title: Confronting Kähler moduli inflation with CMB data

evidence.text: How do the model-dependent duration of post-inflationary modulus domination and uncertain reheating alter the pivot e-fold count, inferred microscopic parameters, and CMB compatibility of Kähler moduli inflation?

sources.title: Pole N-flation

evidence.text: Can collective motion of many open-string moduli realize pole inflation with improved radiative control, retain its universal predictions, and evade the WGC restriction on access to the inflationary plateau?

sources.title: Finite temperature effects in modular cosmology

evidence.text: How do finite-temperature deformations of a light modulus potential affect stabilization, post-inflationary domination, final reheating, inflationary e-fold matching, and possible oscillon instabilities?

sources.title: Sequestered Inflation

evidence.text: Can low-scale inflation be sequestered from the superheavy sector stabilizing moduli, while retaining the moduli-space geometry responsible for inflationary plateau behavior?

sources.title: RG-induced modulus stabilization: perturbative de Sitter vacua and improved D3-$ \overline{\mathrm{D}3} $ inflation

evidence.text: Can renormalization-group resummation stabilize exponentially large moduli within perturbative control, permit de Sitter minima without separate uplifting, and improve warped D3–anti-D3 inflation while separating inflationary and late-time scales?

sources.title: Moduli inflation from modular flavor symmetries

evidence.text: Can a modulus associated with modular flavor symmetry drive observationally viable slow-roll inflation, remain controlled along its complex trajectory, and settle into a flavor-relevant vacuum?

sources.title: String cosmology: From the early universe to today

evidence.text: How can string compactifications and moduli dynamics underpin inflation, post-inflationary evolution and dark energy, and which construction, control and observational challenges remain?

sources.title: String theory and the first half of the universe

evidence.text: How do moduli-driven epochs between inflation and nucleosynthesis change background evolution, cosmological perturbations and particle cosmology, particularly when the volume modulus traverses trans-Planckian field distances?

sources.title: Global embedding of fiber inflation in a perturbative large volume scenario

evidence.text: Can Fibre inflation be embedded in perturbative LVS with sufficient inflaton range and viable observables, while respecting Kähler-cone constraints and effective-supergravity control?

sources.title: From inflation to quintessence: a history of the universe in string theory

evidence.text: Can a moduli-stabilised type IIB effective theory accommodate high-scale inflation, reheating and late axion quintessence while retaining effective-field-theory control and satisfying cosmological constraints?

sources.title: R$^{2}$-inflation derived from 4d strings, the role of the dilaton, and turning the Swampland into a mirage

evidence.text: Can existing string-spectrum scalars realize Starobinsky-like inflation with a naturally small scale, stable additional scalars, and a light-state tower compatible with inflationary EFT? What role does the string dilaton play in the scalar-tensor and supersymmetric descriptions?

sources.title: Inflationary constraints on the moduli-dependent species scale in modular invariant theories

evidence.text: Can inflationary observations directly constrain the moduli-dependent gravitational species scale in modular-invariant inflation, including extensions to generic Calabi–Yau threefolds?

sources.title: Effect of moduli redefinitions on fibre inflation

evidence.text: Can a logarithmic redefinition of the base modulus in perturbative LVS alter fibre-inflation predictions toward the ACT-favoured spectral tilt quoted by the paper, while supporting subsequent axion quintessence and a partial dark-matter component?

sources.title: Loop Blow-up Inflation: An Overview

evidence.text: Can string-loop corrections that spoil the original non-perturbative blow-up inflation regime instead generate controlled inflation, and what predictions follow after accounting for moduli reheating and dark radiation? This v2 proceedings overview summarizes earlier work and updates observational comparisons and Scenario III parameters.

sources.title: Inflation in realistic D-brane models

evidence.text: Can D3/anti-D3 inflation survive moduli stabilization in warped string models containing Standard Model-like sectors, when the remaining light moduli evolve, and what tuning and CMB signatures result?

sources.title: Racetrack inflation

evidence.text: Can a modified racetrack potential yield slow-roll, eternal topological inflation from a geometric modulus without moving branes, and can an irrational extension furnish sufficiently varied vacua for cosmological applications?

sources.title: On inflation in string theory

evidence.text: Can inflation with stabilized moduli be reliably derived from string theory, and which model assumptions could cosmological measurements of scalar tilt, primordial tensors and cosmic strings test?

sources.title: Accidental Inflation in String Theory

evidence.text: Tune the uplifted racetrack potential so that a higher minimum approaches its separating barrier. Numerically integrate the noncanonical modulus equation using e-fold time and calculate the curvature spectrum at horizon crossing.

sources.title: String moduli inflation: An overview

evidence.text: The η-problem is illustrated by expanding the supergravity exponential prefactor around a canonical Kähler potential and examining slow-roll derivatives. The Lyth relation connects tensor amplitude to canonical field excursion over the observable interval.

sources.title: Power Suppression at Large Scales in String Inflation

evidence.text: Background evolution is written in e-fold time, making the trajectory φ′≈−∂φ ln V a dynamical attractor. The kinematic quantity Ξ=φ″/φ′ tracks departure from slow roll, including the transition between exponential-potential dynamics and the plateau.

sources.title: String cosmology — Large-field inflation in string theory

evidence.text: For two-axion alignment, p₂/p₁=q₂/q₁ produces a flat direction; small misalignment lifts it with an effective decay constant increasing as inverse misalignment. Smaller starting decay constants require tighter tuning. Hierarchical decay constants provide another reviewed route.

sources.title: Robust Inflation from Fibrous Strings

evidence.text: Restrict the Kähler metric to fixed overall volume, canonically normalize two-cycle coordinates, and examine general two-field cubic volumes and their large-volume asymptotics. The generalized analysis addresses the inflationary regime rather than the full stabilized potential.

sources.title: Moduli Vacuum Misalignment and Precise Predictions in String Inflation

evidence.text: Apply horizon matching, Ne+(Nmod1+Nmod2)/4≈57+(ln r)/4+ln(ρ*/ρend)/4, then evaluate single-field slow-roll predictions and scalar-amplitude normalization. The latter retains the explicit gs e^{Kcs}/(8π) potential-normalization factor.

sources.title: Induced moduli oscillation by radiation and space expansion in a higher-dimensional model

evidence.text: How does bulk radiation initially hotter than the compactification scale induce oscillations of stabilized moduli, alter three-dimensional expansion, and determine transitions between radiation and moduli domination?

sources.title: Inflationary constraints on modulus dominated cosmology

evidence.text: What constraint on a late-decaying modulus mass follows from matching the expansion history between inflationary horizon exit and today, when the modulus dominates before reheating the visible sector?

sources.title: The Swampland Conjecture and F-term Axion Monodromy Inflation

evidence.text: Can an effectively small inflaton coupling or a different compactification regime enlarge the controlled field range once the integrated-out sector, parameter correlations, and every relevant Kaluza–Klein scale are included?

sources.title: Fitting string inflation to real cosmological data: The fiber inflation case

evidence.text: Which combinations of Fibre Inflation parameters fit the cosmological datasets used in this 2020 analysis, and what conditional bounds do those fits impose on underlying string coupling, compactification volume and discrete brane flux?

sources.title: String Cosmology

evidence.text: These lectures review how string theory might accommodate a small cosmological constant and inflation, emphasizing moduli stabilization, obstacles to flat inflaton potentials, possible remedies, and observational signatures.

sources.title: Wilson line inflation

evidence.text: Can continuous Wilson lines provide string-theoretic inflatons with controlled slow roll, a tachyonic exit, and compatibility with moduli stabilization?

sources.title: Swampland distance conjecture, inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: How does the number of diverging moduli affect asymptotic metric and inflationary bounds?

sources.title: Starobinsky inflation from string theory?

evidence.text: Can a controlled string compactification reproduce both the Starobinsky scalar potential and its fixed conformal coupling to matter fermions, rather than only an observationally similar inflationary plateau?

sources.title: Modulated Reheating and Large Non-Gaussianity in String Cosmology

evidence.text: Can an explicit string-inflation construction support a light field that modulates visible-sector reheating, dominates primordial curvature perturbations, and produces appreciable local non-Gaussianity while avoiding curvaton contributions?

sources.title: Thermal, trapped and chromo-natural inflation in light of the swampland criteria and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can repeated production of particles near enhanced-symmetry points slow a modulus sufficiently to inflate on a steep potential?

sources.title: Higgs-otic Inflation and Moduli Stabilization

evidence.text: Can large-field D7-brane inflation remain controlled after stabilizing the closed-string moduli, accounting for backreaction on both the scalar potential and the canonical inflaton distance?

sources.title: Low-scale Inflation and Supersymmetry Breaking in Racetrack Models

evidence.text: Can a single-modulus racetrack model support inflation with Hinf∼m3/2∼30–50 TeV, acceptable primordial perturbations and early gravitino decay, and what constraints would this place on visible-sector soft masses?

sources.title: Non-standard primordial fluctuations and nongaussianity in string inflation

evidence.text: Can light non-inflaton moduli in a calculable LARGE Volume string-inflation setup generate the dominant primordial curvature fluctuations through post-inflationary conversion, with sizeable local nongaussianity and viable reheating?

sources.title: O'KKLT at finite temperature

evidence.text: Can reheating destabilize a previously stabilized modulus? The paper reinterprets its calculation as a scenario beginning in the zero-temperature de Sitter vacuum.

sources.title: Higgs-otic Inflation and String Theory

evidence.text: Can the neutral MSSM Higgs sector drive chaotic-like inflation through string monodromy, while leaving a fine-tuned light SM Higgs and controlling corrections during trans-Planckian field excursions?

sources.title: Preheating After Modular Inflation

evidence.text: How does the inflaton condensate decay after Kähler-moduli/Roulette inflation, and how does energy subsequently reach visible particles when the Standard Model wraps either the inflationary cycle or another cycle, or when the inflationary cycle becomes string-sized?

sources.title: Effects of reheating on moduli stabilization

evidence.text: Does thermal removal of a modulus potential minimum actually cause cosmological destabilization, and how does the finite time required to generate radiation during reheating change the stabilizing initial-field interval and its relation to BBN constraints?

sources.title: Revisiting oscillon formation in the Kachru-Kallosh-Linde-Trivedi scenario

evidence.text: Does a displaced KKLT volume modulus form oscillons when its initial displacement and Hubble rate are chosen to represent the onset of rolling, and how narrowly must those initial conditions be tuned?

sources.title: Reheating for Closed String Inflation

evidence.text: Can blow-up and fibre inflation transfer energy predominantly into visible MSSM degrees of freedom before BBN, while maintaining controlled moduli stabilisation, acceptable hidden sectors and possibly TeV-scale supersymmetry?

sources.title: Primordial Gravitational Waves and the Swampland

evidence.text: The string-spectrum discussion asks how large the separation between the inflaton and the first omitted state can reasonably be. A large ratio to an unrelated higher state would not establish the required light–heavy decoupling.

sources.title: Backreaction in Axion Monodromy, 4-forms and the Swampland

evidence.text: Can stabilized moduli generate a small effective inflaton-lifting coefficient while preserving their own stabilization? Such a mechanism could evade the bare-integer restriction but must still satisfy the control conditions that blocked simpler constructions.

sources.title: Warped tachyonic inflation in type IIB flux compactifications and the open-string completeness conjecture

evidence.text: Can warping and world-volume fluxes support open-string tachyon inflation within KKLT-inspired moduli stabilization, satisfying e-fold and perturbation requirements while admitting initial conditions motivated by open-string completeness?

sources.title: Fibre Inflation and $\alpha$-attractors

evidence.text: How does LVS fibre inflation realize α-attractor dynamics, which values of α arise, how do string corrections limit the plateau, and can effective supergravity capture stabilization, inflation and its exit?

sources.title: String Inflation After Planck 2013

evidence.text: How do string-inflation models fare against Planck 2013 constraints on spectral tilt, primordial tensors, non-Gaussianity and dark radiation, and what does their theoretical control suggest about future tensor searches?

sources.title: Inflationary string theory?

evidence.text: How can controlled string-inspired constructions produce inflation after moduli stabilization, and what might the difficulty obtaining sufficient inflation imply? The article reviews selected recent work and explicitly separates speculative implications from the constructions.

sources.title: Thermal inflation and the moduli problem

evidence.text: Can a short, low-scale epoch driven by a thermally trapped scalar dilute dangerous Polonyi/moduli relics without excessive regeneration or disruption of the density perturbation generated by ordinary inflation?

sources.title: Warm warped throats

evidence.text: Can dissipation make moduli-stabilized radial and angular D3-brane inflation compatible with the observational constraints used in the paper, while retaining sub-Planckian excursions and, for angular inflation, a sub-Planckian effective decay constant?

sources.title: Chameleonic inflation

evidence.text: Can one compactification-volume scalar drive early slow-roll inflation, subsequently traverse a large region of negligible potential, and reach a late-time chameleon-screening regime before standard cosmology must begin?

sources.title: Probing string theory with modulated cosmological fluctuations

evidence.text: Can inflationary fluctuations of light moduli generate observable relic and curvature perturbations through early spatial variations of couplings, even after those couplings become homogeneous?

sources.title: Global Asymptotics, the Swampland Conjectures, and Preheating of String Moduli

evidence.text: Can displaced string moduli efficiently preheat through self-interactions within EFT control, and how do global potential asymptotics and Swampland-motivated light towers alter resonance?

sources.title: Trans-Planckian censorship conjecture and nonthermal post-inflationary history

evidence.text: How much does an intermediate pre-BBN matter-dominated era relax the TCC upper bound on the inflationary Hubble scale, and can that increase permit inflation to displace gravitationally coupled moduli heavy enough to decay before BBN?

sources.title: Towards an explicit model of large field inflation

evidence.text: Can unwinding inflation support a super-Planckian field excursion with stabilized string moduli after including Kähler-modulus backreaction and leading antibrane effects on the throat geometry?

sources.title: Prospects for Primordial Gravitational Waves in String Inflation

evidence.text: How large can the CMB tensor-to-scalar ratio be when inflation admits both a perturbative-string description and a controlled four-dimensional effective field theory with separated inflationary, Kaluza–Klein and string scales?

sources.title: Catch-me-if-you-can: the overshoot problem and the weak/inflation hierarchy

evidence.text: Can small post-inflationary radiation seeds prevent the LVS volume modulus from overshooting its vacuum, and what hierarchy between inflation and the weak scale makes this possible?

sources.title: Quintessence and the Swampland: The Numerically Controlled Regime of Moduli Space

evidence.text: Can string compactifications support phenomenologically viable quintessence under numerical perturbative control, while surviving inflationary volume destabilisation and generating the inflation–dark-energy hierarchy?

sources.title: Inflation in string theory: A Graceful exit to the real world

evidence.text: Can closed-string inflation transfer its energy predominantly to visible Standard Model degrees of freedom before BBN while retaining viable moduli stabilisation and inflationary perturbations? The central obstacle is that a gauge-singlet inflaton generally couples to hidden sectors as well.

sources.title: Mass Hierarchies and Dynamical Field Range

evidence.text: Observable tensor modes motivate large inflationary field displacements while raising the Hubble scale. A string construction must fit stabilized moduli, Kaluza-Klein states, and string states into the remaining hierarchy without losing control during axion motion.

sources.title: Thermal, trapped and chromo-natural inflation in light of the swampland criteria and the trans-Planckian censorship conjecture

evidence.text: Can a low-scale scalar vacuum energy produce a short late period of inflation that dilutes early-universe moduli?

sources.title: Fluxbranes: Moduli Stabilisation and Inflation

evidence.text: Can fluxbrane inflation be combined with controlled moduli stabilization while satisfying the paper's historical curvature-perturbation and cosmic-string constraints, preserving an inflaton flat direction and avoiding an effectively constant FI term?

destinations.title: Can a simple type IIB volume-modulus model realize accidental inflation, and can its fine-tuned saddle or inflection-point dynamics yield statistical predictions when embedded in a volume-weighted landscape scenario?

How can closed string moduli drive controlled slow-roll inflation after moduli stabilization, which mechanisms address the η-problem, and what observable signatures distinguish the reviewed scenarios?

Could a transition in closed-string-modulus inflation generate the historically reported low-multipole CMB power suppression, and can Fibre Inflation connect the transition's timing and strength to string coupling and potential parameters?

How can string theory provide symmetry protection, a trans-Planckian inflaton range and controlled moduli dynamics for large-field inflation, particularly axion monodromy, while connecting the construction to the scalar tilt n_s and tensor-to-scalar ratio r?
How robust are Fibre Inflation potentials and predictions under UV corrections, modulus stabilization and geometric generalization, and how large can their tensor signal become?
How does explicitly computed moduli vacuum misalignment change the post-inflationary history, preferred horizon-exit e-fold number Ne, and observable predictions of Kähler moduli inflation?

How do reheating and a post-inflationary epoch dominated by cold volume-modulus particles change the inferred horizon-exit e-fold count and spectral tilt of Kähler moduli inflation, and its compatibility with the Planck datasets available to the authors?
When can displaced string moduli fragment into oscillons during relaxation toward their post-inflationary minima, and what gravitational-wave signals or decompactification risks follow?

Can fibre inflation admit a globally consistent embedding with chiral D7 matter and closed-string moduli stabilisation while satisfying Kähler-cone bounds, effective-field-theory hierarchies and primordial-perturbation requirements?

How do the model-dependent duration of post-inflationary modulus domination and uncertain reheating alter the pivot e-fold count, inferred microscopic parameters, and CMB compatibility of Kähler moduli inflation?

Can collective motion of many open-string moduli realize pole inflation with improved radiative control, retain its universal predictions, and evade the WGC restriction on access to the inflationary plateau?

How do finite-temperature deformations of a light modulus potential affect stabilization, post-inflationary domination, final reheating, inflationary e-fold matching, and possible oscillon instabilities?
Can low-scale inflation be sequestered from the superheavy sector stabilizing moduli, while retaining the moduli-space geometry responsible for inflationary plateau behavior?

Can renormalization-group resummation stabilize exponentially large moduli within perturbative control, permit de Sitter minima without separate uplifting, and improve warped D3–anti-D3 inflation while separating inflationary and late-time scales?
Can a modulus associated with modular flavor symmetry drive observationally viable slow-roll inflation, remain controlled along its complex trajectory, and settle into a flavor-relevant vacuum?
How can string compactifications and moduli dynamics underpin inflation, post-inflationary evolution and dark energy, and which construction, control and observational challenges remain?

How do moduli-driven epochs between inflation and nucleosynthesis change background evolution, cosmological perturbations and particle cosmology, particularly when the volume modulus traverses trans-Planckian field distances?
Can Fibre inflation be embedded in perturbative LVS with sufficient inflaton range and viable observables, while respecting Kähler-cone constraints and effective-supergravity control?

Can a moduli-stabilised type IIB effective theory accommodate high-scale inflation, reheating and late axion quintessence while retaining effective-field-theory control and satisfying cosmological constraints?

Can existing string-spectrum scalars realize Starobinsky-like inflation with a naturally small scale, stable additional scalars, and a light-state tower compatible with inflationary EFT? What role does the string dilaton play in the scalar-tensor and supersymmetric descriptions?
Can inflationary observations directly constrain the moduli-dependent gravitational species scale in modular-invariant inflation, including extensions to generic Calabi–Yau threefolds?

Can a logarithmic redefinition of the base modulus in perturbative LVS alter fibre-inflation predictions toward the ACT-favoured spectral tilt quoted by the paper, while supporting subsequent axion quintessence and a partial dark-matter component?

Can string-loop corrections that spoil the original non-perturbative blow-up inflation regime instead generate controlled inflation, and what predictions follow after accounting for moduli reheating and dark radiation? This v2 proceedings overview summarizes earlier work and updates observational comparisons and Scenario III parameters.

Can D3/anti-D3 inflation survive moduli stabilization in warped string models containing Standard Model-like sectors, when the remaining light moduli evolve, and what tuning and CMB signatures result?

Can a modified racetrack potential yield slow-roll, eternal topological inflation from a geometric modulus without moving branes, and can an irrational extension furnish sufficiently varied vacua for cosmological applications?
Can inflation with stabilized moduli be reliably derived from string theory, and which model assumptions could cosmological measurements of scalar tilt, primordial tensors and cosmic strings test?
